hook: Thukkuguda's weekly market sells shirts and trousers for *₹50*
hook_b: Thukkuguda's weekly market sells shirts and trousers for *₹50*
tldr: Second-hand clothes at ₹50 a piece are drawing migrant workers to Thukkuguda's weekly market, Telangana Today reports.

beats.what: Vendors like Renuka travel from Champapet every week to sell used garments; most buyers work at construction sites and nearby units.
beats.why: Workers from other States want to keep daily costs low, vendors and buyers say.
beats.care: The market shows how fast the airport-side belt around Thukkuguda is filling with new workers.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today (Nov 16): a worker from Bihar told the paper ₹50 a pair is affordable when there are many other expenses to manage.
